data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? Taking 19 tons each would leave only 5 tons—safe from immediate collapse, but next month could start with just 10. I propose 18 tons each this month, leaving 10: next month’s stock would be either 100 or 20, not a guaranteed refill. Then we adjust our whole-ton quotas to the stock actually available, always leaving at least 5 tons. If the stock is too low for equal catches, we can rotate who gets the extra tons. Our catches will be public afterward, so we can check whether everyone kept the agreement. John, would you support that?
